passages.text:
Many thanks for making the link on this, Gerry, most appreciated and very timely.
Clare: I hope you are well! Gerry told me about your conversation related to engagement of the advertising sector on
disinformation matters, and we would be very interested to hear more from you and your resource expert; and to tell you
more on our end about our plans under the about-to-be-launched "Ads for News" activity of the Initiative for Media
Freedom.
Shall we set a call sometime in the coming week(s) to discuss this?
We are in the process of finalizing the selection of the Philippine organization which will serve as implementing partner for
this activity, so for now it would be Internews personnel only on our side. The meeting would be attended by:
[opaque block]
• [contact omitted] Kehailia
• [contact omitted] Raymundo ), Media Engagement Specialist
• [contact omitted] Libot ( , Senior Program Officer
• [contact omitted] Lagman, Research Project Officer
• If available, [contact omitted] Lambert, senior director for media business.
SinceJason is Denmark-based,it would be great if we could identify two or three dates when a meeting at 3pm or later
would be doable for the Facebook team.
Looking forward to discussing this!
Best,
Greg
Greg Kehailia | Country Director, Internews Philippines | Chief of Party, Initiative for Media Freedom [contact omitted]
[opaque block]
